Introduction To The Superstar's Wealth

Kamal Haasan remains one of the absolute titans of Indian cinema, boasting a career that spans several decades. Born on November 7, 1954, the veteran performer has transitioned remarkably from a child artist to a celebrated superstar primarily anchored in Tamil cinema.

Beyond his regional stronghold, he has successfully worked across multiple Indian film industries, including Hindi, Telugu, and Malayalam cinema. As he commences shooting for his upcoming venture Sandiyar, public interest has naturally gravitated toward the scale of his massive financial standing.

Estimated Net Worth And Financial Scale

Reports circulating across various media platforms estimate Kamal Haasan's total net worth to be approximately Rs 450 crore. This extensive financial empire has been built over many years of dedicated work in the entertainment industry, encompassing diverse revenue streams.

While these figures are derived from public information and media reports rather than official declarations, they highlight the immense commercial value and enduring market stature of the 72-year-old actor.

Lucrative Acting Fees And Remuneration

Acting remains the primary source of wealth for the veteran star, who commands some of the highest remuneration figures in South Indian cinema. According to reports from CNBC TV18, he typically charges around Rs 100 crore per project.

Demonstrating his formidable box office pull, reports from News Minute further indicate that he demanded a staggering Rs 150 crore to reprise his iconic character in the sequel Indian 2.

Raaj Kamal Films International Ventures

In addition to his acting income, Kamal Haasan has established a strong foothold on the business side of filmmaking through his own production banner. He founded Raaj Kamal Films International in the year 1981.

The production house launched its cinematic journey with Raja Paarvai in 1981, subsequently backing notable projects over the years such as Amavasya Chandrudu, Kadamai Kanniyam Kattupaadu, and Magalir Mattum.

Luxury Cars And Garage Collection

The superstar's affinity for luxury is clearly reflected in his impressive collection of high-end vehicles. His garage houses some of the most expensive rides available on the market.

Notable vehicles owned by the actor include a Lexus LX 570 valued at Rs 2.8 crore and a sophisticated BMW 730LD priced at approximately Rs 1.37 crore, among other luxury acquisitions.

Extensive Real Estate Portfolio In Chennai

Real estate forms a substantial component of the actor's reported Rs 450 crore empire, with multiple high-value assets located primarily in Chennai. According to reports cited by News Minute, he owns agricultural land valued at Rs 17.79 crore.

Additionally, the star possesses two luxurious residential flats priced at a combined total of Rs 19.5 crore, alongside commercial properties whose market value is estimated to be around Rs 92.05 crore.

Current Work Front And Upcoming Projects

Kamal Haasan continues to maintain an active schedule in cinema. He was last seen on the big screen in the Mani Ratnam-directed action drama Thug Life, which received a theatrical release on June 5, 2025.

Looking ahead, his upcoming slate includes Seyon, a Tamil film directed by Sivakumar Murugesan featuring Bhagyashri Borse, Raj B. Shetty, and Bala Saravanan, alongside S U Arun Kumar's action thriller Sandiyar.

The Blockbuster Partnership Returns

Bollywood star Ranveer Singh and acclaimed filmmaker Aditya Dhar are reportedly preparing to join forces once again for an ambitious new feature film. The actor-director pairing previously created immense waves at the box office, driving significant commercial success with their earlier projects.

Industry insiders indicate that this upcoming collaboration is being designed on a massive scale, drawing considerable attention from fans and trade analysts alike who are eager to see what the successful duo will deliver next.

Production Timelines and Release Plans

Current reports suggest that the makers are aiming for a theatrical premiere in the year 2028. Production is slated to commence in 2027, giving the creative team ample time for pre-production and thorough planning.

While the shooting schedules are yet to be officially locked down, the project has already established a clear trajectory toward its anticipated launch window.

Speculation Surrounding the Plot and Historical Epics

Although initial rumors led many followers to expect a third installment in their previous franchise, fresh speculation points toward an entirely different direction. Word has spread that Dhar might be shaping a historical epic focusing on Chandragupta Maurya and the expansion of the Mauryan Empire.

As of now, the production team has kept the official title, primary genre, and detailed plot lines tightly under wraps, leaving audiences to anticipate official announcements.

Legacy of the 'Dhurandhar' Franchise

The momentum for this new partnership stems largely from the extraordinary financial achievements of 'Dhurandhar' and 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge'. Together, these films crossed the milestone of Rs 3,000 crore worldwide.

That combined performance cemented the franchise as one of the most commercially dominant forces in contemporary Indian cinema, setting exceptionally high expectations for whatever project the actor and director choose to pursue next.

Current Endeavors and Cast Developments

While preparations for the upcoming Aditya Dhar venture continue behind the scenes, Ranveer Singh remains actively engaged in other cinematic commitments. The actor is currently involved in shooting 'Pralay', a post-apocalyptic thriller directed by Jai Mehta.

Meanwhile, speculation regarding the broader cast for Dhar's prospective historical venture continues to circulate, with various reports linking multiple prominent actors from different film industries to the ambitious undertaking.

Actor Ranveer Singh and director Aditya Dhar are reportedly reuniting for an upcoming big-budget film projected to hit theaters in 2028 following production in 2027. While official plot details and titles remain unannounced, the collaboration builds upon the massive worldwide success of their previous franchise work.

At the same time, Ranveer is currently busy filming the post-apocalyptic thriller 'Pralay' under the direction of Jai Mehta.

ld.articleBody:
Director's Vision for the Adaptation

Director Peter Berg has offered clear insights into the upcoming adaptation of the mega-hit video game franchise, assuring audiences that the project will steer clear of standard comic book tropes. Instead of treating its soldiers as cartoon heroes or invincible figures, the film aims to portray them as complex human beings dealing with very real burdens.

Speaking to ComicBook in late October 2026, Berg emphasized that the production is designed to carry substantial emotional weight rather than serving as a mindless action spectacle. The creative team is deliberately aiming for a dramatic and grounded exploration of military life.

Drawing Inspiration from Modern Warfare

The cinematic project specifically draws from the Modern Warfare storyline, centering around iconic figures such as Captain Price, Soap, Ghost, and Alex. Berg highlighted that these characters provide a strong foundation for rich dramatic storytelling because of their nuanced arcs and the intrinsic soul of the Modern Warfare universe.

While acknowledging that violence, military hardware, and combat are inherent parts of the franchise, Berg stressed that those elements exist on top of a much deeper thematic core. The narrative is fundamentally about the heavy toll paid by warriors who place themselves in harm's way.

The Creative Partnership with Taylor Sheridan

Screenwriter Taylor Sheridan, widely known for his work on Yellowstone, Sicario, and Hell or High Water, penned the script for the film. Berg noted that he and Sheridan share a mutual understanding of what the source material requires to feel authentic and resonant.

This shared vision ensures that the movie retains a strong soul and a sharp focus on the consequences of armed conflict, setting it apart from standard popcorn action shooters that prioritize quantity over quality.

Escaping the Popcorn Shooter Mold

Given that Call of Duty is one of the largest entertainment properties globally—boasting 1 billion players and $35 billion in lifetime revenue according to Paramount—a project of this magnitude could easily have devolved into pure, unadulterated popcorn entertainment.

However, Berg's approach signals an intentional departure from mindless spectacle, bringing an artistic seriousness reminiscent of his earlier military-focused films like Lone Survivor and The Kingdom.

Evolution of the Director's Perspective

Berg's current embrace of the franchise marks a notable evolution from his previous remarks. Back in 2013, the filmmaker offered sharp criticism of war video games, labeling them pathetic and referring to the medium as keyboard courage.

His pivot to praising the storytelling and characters of the Modern Warfare universe in late 2026 demonstrates a profound change in perspective, treating the source material with genuine artistic respect rather than viewing it as a promotional obligation.

Production Timeline and Release Details

Paramount officially locked in the theatrical release date during its CinemaCon presentation in April 2026, scheduling the wide release for June 30, 2028. The film is a collaborative production involving Skydance, Paramount, and Activision Blizzard Studios.

As the project moves steadily toward its 2028 premiere in domestic and international markets, the studio has yet to announce casting decisions or specific plot details beyond its foundation in the Modern Warfare setting.

Midway Through the Royal Drama

The royal romance drama The Remarried Empress has firmly captured the attention of international K-drama audiences. Based on Alpha Tart's widely read web novel, the series has officially passed its halfway point, bringing a flood of unpredictable narrative twists that leave viewers constantly guessing.

Despite encountering some critique, the production remains a major focal point for discussions across streaming communities. Fans eagerly dissect every single scene as the narrative moves swiftly toward its most critical turning points.

Star-Studded Cast and Key Characters

The series features a prominent ensemble cast. Shin Min Ah stars as Navier, the dignified, brilliant, and elegant Empress of the Eastern Empire. Ju Ji Hoon portrays her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, who becomes entirely captivated by his mistress Rashta, played by Lee Se Young.

Rounding out the main cast is Lee Jong Suk in the role of Heinrey, the charming prince of the Western Kingdom. Together, these actors bring immense depth and emotional weight to the ongoing royal tensions.

Recap of Last Week's Major Surprises

In the previous fifth and sixth episodes, audiences learned that Rashta is pregnant, with the palace assuming Sovieshu is the father. Blinded by her appearance and charm, Sovieshu actively alienates Navier, creating a deep rift in their marriage.

Meanwhile, Prince Heinrey continues trying to grow closer to Navier, having developed genuine feelings for her. Last week's broadcasts concluded on a dramatic cliffhanger when an unknown assailant tried to attack Heinrey with a sword right after an emotional moment and embrace with Navier.

The Identity of the Attacker Revealed

Previews for the upcoming seventh and eighth episodes show that the sword-wielding intruder is actually Navier's brother, Kosair. Incensed by how Sovieshu and Rashta have treated his sister, Kosair intends to put a stop to their affair.

When Rashta attempts to approach Navier and Kosair in the palace gardens later, Kosair makes his profound dislike for her plainly obvious. Shortly after this encounter, Rashta sits down while clutching her stomach.

Sovieshu's Wrath and Prison Sentences

Upon discovering the confrontation, a furious Sovieshu blames both Navier and Kosair for Rashta's physical state, claiming their hostility endangered his unborn child. This leads Kosair to start investigating Rashta's background and family roots.

Kosair's snooping only infuriates the emperor further, resulting in Sovieshu having Navier's brother thrown straight into prison. Simultaneously, Navier grows increasingly suspicious of Rashta as whispers about the true paternity of the unborn child begin circulating through the halls.

Heinrey's Steadfast Support

Amidst the escalating chaos within the empire, Prince Heinrey poses a direct question to Navier, asking if she truly loves Sovieshu. His concern highlights his growing commitment to her.

Heinrey remains resolute in his determination to stand by Navier's side, offering a steady shoulder as she navigates this immensely difficult and politically perilous environment.

Introduction to the New Era

Marvel Comics has officially unveiled a chilling new codename for Steve Rogers, shedding the iconic Captain America mantle for a much darker identity. This shocking transition takes place within the context of the upcoming comic book event titled Hulk War, introducing a completely different status quo for the legendary hero.

Unlike previous eras where titles were passed down to trusted allies like Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes, this latest development plunges the character into an entirely unexpected direction. Fans are introduced to a terrifying interpretation of Steve Rogers that breaks away from traditional superhero tropes.

The Infernal Avengers Lineup

Six months after the initial reveal of the Infernal Hulk's army, Marvel has officially named the members of this nightmarish iteration of the Avengers. Alongside Steve Rogers, other classic heroes receive horrific transformations and new titles tailored for the impending conflict.

The newly released character sheets highlight dramatic evolutions across the roster. Tony Stark becomes known as 'The Iron Thing', Spider-Man transforms into 'The Arthropod', Captain Marvel takes on the title of 'The Ebon Sphinx', Jubilee evolves into 'The Angler', and Vision is redefined as 'Diaboli Ex Machina'.

The Gruesome Redesign of Steve Rogers

Among all the members of the Infernal Hulk's team, the redesign given to Steve Rogers stands out as the most macabre. Rather than receiving a physical mutation or a powered-up exoskeleton like his peers, his fate takes a distinctly morbid turn.

Steve Rogers is depicted as crucified, bearing multiple spear wounds through his chest, back, and hands decorated with skulls. His unconscious or lifeless body is hoisted and carried by four zombie soldiers who are bathed entirely in his blood.

Introducing The War Dead

The official codename assigned to Steve Rogers for this dark team is 'The War Dead'. Designed by artist Nic Klein, the character sheet provides a closer look at the terrifyingly impractical nature of this new persona.

While teammates like the muscular Iron Thing and the energy-based Angler possess active combat capabilities, The War Dead appears physically incapacitated. The platform supporting his crucified body relies entirely on the strength of the undead soldiers carrying the weight.

Historical Legacy of the Shield

Throughout comic book history, the Captain America mantle has seen numerous official and unofficial successors. Following Steve Rogers' apparent disappearance in 1945, figures like William Nasland and Jeffrey Mace briefly wore the uniform to sustain public morale.

Other notable successors and impostors over the decades have included Isaiah Bradley, William Burnside during the Cold War, and Roscoe Simons. Even Steve himself has experienced dark variants in the past, such as his Captain Hydra clone during Secret Empire.

Power Dynamics of the Infernal Hulk's Army

Led by the Eldest-possessed body of the Hulk, the Infernal Hulk has established an imposing and nearly unbeatable force. The inclusion of heavy hitters like the colossal Arthropod and the flying Ebon Sphinx increases the threat level exponentially.

While Diaboli Ex Machina retains all of Vision's overpowered abilities without any moral restraints, The War Dead serves a primarily symbolic and gruesome role within the ranks of the monster Avengers.

Publication Details and Availability

Readers looking to witness the unfolding narrative of the upcoming conflict can find the details in the upcoming comic book release. The storyline officially kicks off with the release of Hulk War: Infernal Rage #1.

Scheduled to hit comic shop shelves on February 3, the issue is published by Marvel Comics and promises to deliver further insight into the horrifying fate of Steve Rogers and his teammates.

ld.articleBody:
A Standout Rom-Com Phenomenon on Streaming

In a crowded streaming landscape filled with endless choices, finding a series that genuinely captures public attention is no small feat. Yet, Netflix's romantic comedy series Nobody Wants This has managed to rise above the rest, establishing itself as a major viewer favorite since its debut in 2024.

Blending humor with a deeply nuanced approach to modern romance, the show has steadily built a passionate fanbase. The recent arrival of its third season has further propelled its popularity, driving a massive surge in watch time and proving that audiences remain deeply invested in the journey of its main characters.

The Core Romance Between Joanne and Noah

At the center of the story is the unexpected and undeniable connection between Joanne, a chaotic podcaster with an agnostic worldview, and Noah, a devout religious leader. Their chance first meeting sparks a romance that instantly defies easy categorization, forcing both characters to reevaluate their perspectives.

The central conflict of the narrative hinges on their contrasting lifestyles and beliefs. While Joanne openly unpacks her messy dating history on her podcast, Noah is navigating the aftermath of a long-term breakup, all while the couple attempts to bridge the vast gap between their spiritual and secular worlds.

Family Pressures and Complicated Dynamics

Beyond the romantic tension between the two leads, the series derives much of its conflict and comedy from their respective families. Noah's strict and overly involved relatives, particularly his meddlesome mother Bina, make it difficult for Joanne to feel entirely welcome in his world.

Simultaneously, Joanne's family adds its own brand of chaos to the mix, featuring her quirky divorced parents and her close yet turbulent relationship with her dramatic sister, Morgan. These contrasting family dynamics create continuous obstacles that test the strength of the central relationship.

Exploring Complex Themes Through Humor

While Nobody Wants This is fundamentally a romantic comedy, it refuses to shy away from heavier, more intricate subjects. The clashing of Noah and Joanne's lifestyles allows the series to examine religious faith and personal belief systems from multiple, thoughtful perspectives.

Rather than relying strictly on standard genre tropes, the show adopts a remarkably grounded tone. This realistic approach to relationship struggles allows it to stand apart from traditional sitcoms, offering viewers a blend of sharp comedy and genuine emotional depth.

A Standout Ensemble Cast

The success of the series is heavily bolstered by its talented supporting ensemble, which brings vibrant energy to every episode. Characters like Morgan, portrayed by Justine Lupe, add sharp wit and familial friction to Joanne's daily life.

Additionally, the show expands its exploration of partnerships through Noah's brother, Sasha, and his wife, Esther, played by Timothy Simons and Jackie Tohn respectively. Their ongoing domestic struggles provide a compelling parallel to the main romance, rounding out the show's rich character web.

Surging Viewership and Season 4 Confirmation

The release of the third season has translated into extraordinary streaming metrics, driving significant watch times and quickly securing a coveted spot in Netflix's Top 10 rankings. This impressive performance underscored the show's enduring cultural footprint.

Capitalizing on this immense momentum, Netflix officially announced a Season 4 renewal for the hit comedy, ensuring that fans will get to follow the continuing adventures of Joanne and Noah even though a formal release date has not yet been confirmed.

ld.articleBody:
The Viral DealBook Summit Interview

Hailey Bieber recently sat down for an appearance at The New York Times DealBook Summit to discuss the ongoing business success of her skincare brand, Rhode Beauty. During the discussion, the conversation turned toward the monumental sale of her company to e.l.f. beauty for $1 billion in the year 2025. Reflecting on the massive valuation, the founder explained that she had set a strict financial boundary for herself, stating she would not let the brand go for anything less than that figure.

Characterizing the ambition required to reach such heights, she remarked that shooting for such an extraordinary number felt entirely crazy. To explain how she navigated the process, she credited a certain sense of what she termed 'optimistical delusion' as a necessary mindset for entrepreneurs looking to achieve massive commercial success on a global scale.

Backlash and Social Media Criticism

Following the release of the interview, the model faced a wave of online mockery from social media users and fans who scrutinized her ability to answer hard-hitting financial questions. Critics pointed out that the discussion was a rigorous corporate interview rather than a casual podcast, leading many observers to argue that she appeared underprepared to discuss corporate management and deep financial strategies.

Commentators across various platforms highlighted her unconventional phrasing, specifically latching onto her use of the word 'optimistical.' Online critics suggested that the exchange demonstrated a lack of close oversight regarding corporate finances, transforming what was intended to be a celebratory business milestone into a viral moment of public ridicule.

Cryptic Social Media Response

Refusing to let the commentary pass without a subtle acknowledgment, the entrepreneur took to Instagram to address the detractors directly. Rather than issuing a lengthy public statement, she opted for a cryptic approach by sharing the formal dictionary definition of the word 'optimistical,' which is documented as an alternative version of optimistic.

Overlaying the dictionary screenshot with the brief caption 'Anyways…,' the model signaled her dismissal of the backlash. The post served as her direct reply to the viral mockery, demonstrating her choice to shrug off the commentary surrounding her vocabulary and interview style.

Past Struggles With Public Scrutiny

Beyond the recent business discussions, the conversation also touched upon the immense psychological toll she experienced during past periods of intense public hostility. She opened up about facing severe online abuse, noting that she had encountered people telling her to harm herself in comment sections every single day while navigating public tensions.

Detailing the severity of the harassment, she recalled walking down the street and encountering hostile reactions, including tip jars set up at local coffee shops contrasting her against another individual. The intense wave of public animosity left her feeling deeply isolated and overwhelmed by the sheer scale of negative emotions directed at her by strangers.

Addressing Feud Rumors

Though she did not explicitly name her husband Justin Bieber's former partner Selena Gomez during the discussion, the painful period she described directly coincided with years of persistent feud rumors fueled by internet culture. The two public figures were frequently cast as rivals by devoted fanbases due to their respective historical romantic ties to the pop singer.

The relentless comparisons and manufactured rivalry created a toxic environment that severely impacted the model's mental health during those challenging years. The constant barrage of hostility made her question her place in the public eye before the narrative surrounding their relationship began to shift.

Putting Rest to the Drama

In a significant turn of events that helped quell the online hostility, the two media personalities actively worked to put the persistent feud rumors to rest. In October 2022, they surprised observers by posing together for friendly photographs at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures gala, signaling unity to the public.

Later, in September 2023, both stars issued direct pleas to their combined millions of social media followers, begging them to stop instigating a non-existent rivalry. Gomez specifically urged her supporters to halt the bullying and death threats directed at her ex-boyfriend's spouse, helping to defuse much of the digital animosity.

Main Competition and Top Winners

The 34th iteration of the Camerimage Film Festival concluded its run in Toruń, Poland, celebrating the finest achievements in global cinematography. During the Saturday closing ceremony, the prestigious event—which adopted the name ToruńCamerimage earlier in the year—distributed its highest honors to several standout cinematic projects.

Topping the main competition was the film Fatherland, earning widespread acclaim and cementing its status as an upcoming Academy Award contender. Cinematographer Lukasz Zal captured the coveted Golden Frog for his exceptional visual work on the feature, which is directed by Pawel Pawlikowski.

Fatherland Plot and Oscar Ambitions

Serving as Poland's official submission for the international feature Oscar, Fatherland transports viewers into a Cold War-era journey through Germany. The narrative follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann, portrayed by Hanns Zischler, alongside his daughter Erika, played by Sandra Hüller, as they embark on an immersive road trip.

The project has picked up significant momentum on the festival circuit, positioning itself as a major player in upcoming international award races alongside its fellow European contenders.

Silver and Bronze Frog Honorees

Other prominent features earned recognition in the main cinematography categories during the festive Polish gathering. Cinematographer Jasper J. Spanning was awarded the Silver Frog for his work on Woman Unknown, a project directed by May El-Toukhy.

Meanwhile, Mikhail Krichman claimed the Bronze Frog for his visual contributions to Minotaur, a film directed by Andrey Zvyagintsev.

Audience Award and Star-Studded Thriller

In addition to the jury selections, festival attendees cast their votes to determine the recipient of the audience award. That honor was claimed by Wild Horse Nine, a comedic spy thriller directed by Martin McDonagh and shot by cinematographer Ben Davis.

The film features high-profile performances from John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell, and it carries substantial Oscar aspirations as it approaches its wider release strategy.

Debuts, Nonfiction, and Specialized Categories

The festival also recognized emerging talent and specialized formats across multiple distinct competitive sections. In the Cinematographers’ Debuts category, Eira Wyn Jones took home the Golden Frog for Effi O Blaenau, directed by Tereza Nvotova, while Kaifeng Zhong secured the Directors’ Debuts Golden Frog for Atlantic Rhapsody.

Nonfiction and episodic storytelling received dedicated spotlights as well. Eva Kraljevic won the Documentary Features Golden Frog for To Hold a Mountain, directed by Petar Glomazic, and Maxim Arbugaev and Vladimir Egorov earned the Documentary Shorts Golden Frog for Chuuraa, directed by Evgenia Arbugaeva. In the television field, Maciej Sobieraj collected the Golden Frog for the series Silent Night, directed by Jan Holoubek.

Music Videos, National Race, and Student Etudes

Additional trophies were handed out for short-form visual storytelling and national cinema achievements. The Music Videos competition saw Jeff Bierman win the Golden Frog for the (LA)HORDE-directed video What You Want.

In Poland's national race, Alan Ruczyński was honored with the Golden Frog for A Free Woman, a project he co-directed alongside Eliza Godlewska. Wrapping up the event, the Film and Art School Etudes Competition awarded the Golden Tadpole to Francesca Avanzini for Revolver, the Silver Tadpole to Paul Ader for Nika's Room, and the Bronze Tadpole to Enrico Barbaro Jr. for Until We Bury Them!

Various other directors, cinematographers, and student creators were recognized with medals ranging from the Silver and Bronze Frogs to the student Tadpoles.

ld.articleBody:
The Official Casting Announcement

DC Studios has officially found its next Robin, with studio co-head Peter Safran confirming that Mason Thames will voice Dick Grayson in the upcoming feature Dynamic Duo. The casting confirmation arrives following months of rumors, including a report by scooper Jeff Sneider in September 2026.

Safran revealed that Thames pursued the role with great enthusiasm, visiting DC offices alongside his father and thoroughly auditioning for the part. The actor is well-known for his prior work in The Black Phone and its sequel, as well as portraying Hiccup in the live-action How to Train Your Dragon film.

Behind the Scenes of Dynamic Duo

Dynamic Duo is an upcoming animated project developed by DC Studios in partnership with Swaybox Studios. The production utilizes a distinctive animation style developed by Swaybox co-founders Arthur Mintz and Theresa Andersson, which blends puppetry and CGI to achieve a stop-motion aesthetic.

The narrative of the film will explore the origin stories of both Dick Grayson and Jason Todd. Alongside Thames, Logan Kim has been cast to voice Jason Todd, though the recasting drew public disappointment from Titans star Curran Walters.

Enthusiasm and Dedication from the Actor

According to studio leadership, Thames demonstrated immense dedication during the audition process, described by Safran as being entirely obsessed with securing the role of Dick Grayson. The 19-year-old actor, who also appeared in the comedy film Idiots alongside Dave Franco and O'Shea Jackson Jr., deeply impressed the studio executives with his passion.

This level of commitment has generated positive expectations for his vocal performance in the upcoming DC Universe feature.

The Live-Action Transition Question

A central question following the casting announcement is whether Thames will transition to playing Dick Grayson in live-action productions. While past remarks from co-head James Gunn suggest that DC Universe actors should portray their characters across film, television, animation, and video games, official confirmation regarding Thames remains absent.

Similar uncertainty surrounds Logan Kim's potential live-action future as Jason Todd within the evolving franchise.

Precedents for Cross-Medium Casting

James Gunn has previously emphasized a unified strategy where performers span multiple formats within the same shared continuity. Frank Grillo serves as a prime example, having portrayed Rick Flag Sr. across the film Superman, the television series Peacemaker, and the animated show Creature Commandos.

Additionally, Aaron Pierre was announced to play Green Lantern John Stewart in both the HBO series Lanterns and the theatrical movie Man of Tomorrow, supporting the studio's goal of maintaining parity between television and film.

Broader Context and Franchise Shifts

The long-term strategy for the DC Universe has faced various adjustments since its initial 2022 announcement by Gunn and Safran. Changes have included canceled projects such as The Authority, alongside shifts driven by corporate developments like the Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount merger in October 2026.

These alterations raise ongoing questions about how strictly the studio will adhere to its original cross-medium actor continuity plans moving forward.

Release Details and Additional Cast

Dynamic Duo is currently scheduled for release on September 22, 2028. Arthur Mintz is attached to direct the feature under the banner of Swaybox Studios.

Additional casting reports indicate that Lee Pace and Steve Buscemi have joined the project to portray members of the Red Hood Gang, though further plot and character details remain limited.

While studio leadership has previously expressed intentions for DC Universe actors to cross over between animation, television, and live-action, official confirmation regarding a live-action role for Thames has not yet been provided.

ld.articleBody:
The Box Office Journey So Far

Jailer 2 has established itself as a massive theatrical triumph, pulling in crowds and rewriting box office benchmarks. The action entertainer directed by Nelson Dilipkumar has achieved a remarkable worldwide gross collection standing at Rs 816.90 crore.

As the feature approaches its next major milestones, it continues to draw steady footfalls across multiple regions, cementing its status as one of the most successful commercial releases of the period.

Day 20 Earnings and Domestic Standing

On its twentieth day in theaters, the Rajinikanth starrer brought in Rs 3.35 crore in India net collections. This latest single-day addition pushes the domestic net total to an impressive Rs 463.05 crore, while the overall India gross currently sits at Rs 541.65 crore.

International markets have further bolstered the earnings, contributing Rs 1 crore on Tuesday alone and raising international gross collections to a notable Rs 275.25 crore.

Chasing The GOAT Record in Tamil Nadu

In the home state of Tamil Nadu, the movie has grossed Rs 210.45 crore across its first 18 days of exhibition. The action drama now requires another Rs 6.80 crore to surpass Thalapathy Vijay's The Greatest Of All Time record.

Surpassing this state benchmark would add another stellar achievement to the film's theatrical run, bringing it neck and neck with previous regional history-makers.

Milestones and Regional Language Success

By crossing the Rs 800 crore threshold globally, Jailer 2 has officially become the first Tamil film to achieve this monumental financial feat. Furthermore, its Kannada-dubbed version has outperformed the collection records set by Allu Arjun's Pushpa 2: The Rule.

The Tamil version remained the primary revenue driver on Day 20, bringing in Rs 1.93 crore from 3,624 shows, followed by contributions from the Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada iterations.

Weekdays and Weekend Trends

The daily collections experienced a minor 1.5 percent decline on Day 20 compared to the Rs 3.40 crore netted on Monday. However, the feature recently enjoyed a strong third weekend that pulled in Rs 30.70 crore in India gross.

During that weekend surge, daily gross earnings climbed from Rs 6.40 crore on Friday to Rs 11.30 crore on Saturday and peaked at Rs 13 crore on Sunday.

Production Background and Cast

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran under Sun Pictures, Jailer 2 serves as the direct sequel to the 2023 hit Jailer.

Superstar Rajinikanth leads the project, reprising his iconic role as the retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian in this high-octane action follow-up.

Initial Box Office Trajectory

The theatrical run of Ramayana: Part 1 has drawn significant attention from trade analysts and moviegoers alike since its premiere. Industry trackers are closely monitoring every update regarding its daily earnings across domestic and international markets.

As the film enters its fourth day in theaters, updates on final figures are still awaited, leaving audiences eager to see how weekday numbers hold up following a strong opening weekend.

Opening Day and Weekend Figures

On its first day, the feature pulled in an impressive nationwide net collection of 62.5 crore rupees across all languages. This opening total included 45 crore rupees from the Hindi version, 7.5 crore rupees from Kannada, 6 crore rupees from Telugu, 2.5 crore rupees from Tamil, and 1.5 crore rupees from Malayalam.

Following the grand premiere, the second day saw a collection of 47.75 crore rupees net. This figure comprised 35 crore rupees in Hindi, 5.25 crore rupees in Kannada, 4.75 crore rupees in Telugu, 1.5 crore rupees in Tamil, and 1.25 crore rupees in Malayalam.

Surge on Day 3

The theatrical earnings experienced a notable boost on the third day, reaching 70.75 crore rupees net overall. The regional breakdown for this day featured 54 crore rupees from the Hindi market, 6.25 crore rupees from Kannada, 6 crore rupees from Telugu, 2.5 crore rupees from Tamil, and 2 crore rupees from Malayalam.

ld.articleBody:
A Candid Admission on Television

Hollywood icon John Travolta recently shared an intimate update regarding his personal life during a television interview. Appearing on an episode of the talk show 'Today' hosted by Craig Melvin, the celebrated actor spoke openly about finding romance again.

When asked if he might be ready to explore romantic relationships following years of solitary focus, Travolta did not hesitate to confirm his openness to the idea. He noted that affection and connection remain fundamental components of his character.

Reflecting on Six Years of Solitude

It has been six full years since the passing of his beloved wife, Kelly Preston. Following her tragic death, Travolta deliberately shifted his primary attention entirely toward his career commitments and nurturing his family through an extraordinarily difficult transition.

Reflecting on the elapsed time, the 72-year-old performer described the period as both challenging and deeply introspective. His main objective throughout these years was to establish a stable foundation and secure future for his younger children.

Stepping Up as a Single Parent

In the wake of his wife's death, Travolta assumed the heavy responsibility of parenting alone. He spoke frankly about stepping into the dual role of both mother and father for his children during their formative years.

Acknowledging the immense difficulty of the endeavor, the star remarked on the necessity of perseverance. He expressed satisfaction that the family unit is steadily finding its footing and moving forward with resilience.

Focusing on the Children's Future

At the time of Preston's passing, their youngest son Benjamin was only nine years old, while their daughter Ella was even younger. Ensuring their emotional well-being took absolute precedence over any personal pursuits for the actor.

Today, the family dynamics have evolved positively. Ella Bleu is now 26 years old, and Benjamin has grown into a 15-year-old teenager, with the household experiencing gradual healing with each passing year.

Remembering Kelly Preston

Kelly Preston passed away in 2020 after enduring a private two-year battle with breast cancer. Travolta personally broke the heartbreaking news to the public at the time through a heartfelt social media statement honoring her courage.

Even years after her departure, the actor frequently keeps her memory alive in the public eye. He routinely shares touching digital tributes dedicated to her on special occasions, including her birthday, wedding anniversaries, and Mother's Day.

Looking Back at Their Romance

The love story of Travolta and Preston spans decades, beginning in 1989 when they crossed paths during auditions for the movie 'The Experts'. Their professional collaboration quickly blossomed into a romantic relationship.

The couple exchanged marriage vows in 1991 and remained devoted partners for nearly three decades until Preston's passing. Together, they shared three children, including their eldest son Jett, who passed away earlier in life at the age of 16.

ld.articleBody:
Regulatory Clearance From BSE

Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited announced that it obtained an observation letter containing no adverse observations from BSE Limited regarding a proposed Composite Scheme of Arrangement. Disclosed through a regulatory filing on November 19, 2026, the clearance acts as a vital checkpoint for the corporate restructuring involving Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited, Shanti Learning Initiatives Private Limited, and Grew Energy Private Limited.

The recent development clears a path forward for GREW Energy to advance toward becoming a publicly listed entity. With the stock exchange's nod secured, the participating entities can proceed with seeking required clearances from the Competition Commission of India, respective shareholders, creditors, and the National Company Law Tribunal.

Understanding the BSE Observation Letter

The no adverse observations letter signifies that BSE reviewed comments from market regulator SEBI and found no objections that would halt Shanti Educational Initiatives from bringing the scheme to the next stage. This grants the company permission to formally file the proposal with the National Company Law Tribunal.

SEBI noted that submitting documents does not translate to official endorsement or financial soundness approval. Furthermore, the BSE holds the authority to revoke the letter if submitted details turn out to be false, misleading, or incomplete, and the letter itself maintains a validity window of six months for filing.

Structure of the Restructuring Plan

The overall scheme centers around three distinct Chiripal Group entities: Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary Shanti Learning Initiatives Private Limited, and the solar manufacturing enterprise Grew Energy Private Limited. The initial plan involves transferring the entire education operations as a going concern to the subsidiary via a slump sale.

Once the education sector is moved, Shanti Educational Initiatives will merge directly into GREW Energy. This strategic sequence paves the way for GREW Energy to enter the stock exchanges while granting existing shareholders direct access to the solar manufacturing venture.

Share Exchange Ratio and Advisers

Under the formulated plan, eligible shareholders of Shanti Educational Initiatives will receive 100 fully paid equity shares of GREW Energy for every 212 fully paid equity shares they hold in Shanti Educational Initiatives, with each share carrying a face value of Re 1. Independent registered valuers Finvox Analytics and A N Gawade arrived at this specific ratio.

Transaction advisers who worked on the arrangement included Ernst Young along with P. Murali Consultants Private Limited. Additionally, the BSE confirmed that this 100 to 212 share exchange ratio remains fixed and will not alter even if any partly paid equity shares of GREW Energy face forfeiture.

Public Shareholding and Disclosures

BSE has mandated comprehensive transparency regarding how the restructuring shifts public and retail investor dynamics. Public shareholding will drop from 50.11 percent in Shanti Educational Initiatives down to 10.03 percent in GREW Energy following the completion of the merger.

To ensure complete clarity, the notice calling for the upcoming shareholder meeting must prominently feature a comparison table on its front page displaying pre- and post-scheme shareholding stakes for promoters, the promoter group, and public shareholders alike.

Promoter Stake and Voting Transparency

Management must explicitly state within the meeting notice that the arrangement increases the overall promoter shareholding percentage. Voting in favor of the proposal automatically signifies that shareholders consent to this rise in promoter stake.

Corporate leadership is required to elaborate on the exact reasoning behind the higher promoter stake and detail the direct impact on public shareholders' rights and overall holding value, urging investors to evaluate these factors carefully before casting their votes.

The arrangement involves a slump sale of education assets, a merger into GREW Energy, a fixed share exchange ratio, and upcoming regulatory approvals from the National Company Law Tribunal and the Competition Commission of India.
